concerns.text: Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires a task that computes and records checksums for the downloaded GSM8K files before they are used. No such task exists in the current list (e.g., a task like ‘T041 Compute and verify checksums for GSM8K dataset’ is missing).

Success Criterion SC‑003 (peak RAM ≤ 7 GB per experimental run) is not directly verified by any task. Existing tasks (T031, T033) only check CI‑level aggregates. Add a task (e.g., ‘T042 Verify per‑run RAM usage does not exceed 7 GB and fail if it does’) to satisfy this criterion.

Success Criterion SC‑004 (wall‑clock ≤ 6 h per experimental run) lacks a dedicated verification task. Current CI sanity test (T031) validates the overall workflow but not each individual run. Add a task (e.g., ‘T043 Verify per‑run wall‑clock time ≤ 360 min and fail otherwise’) to close this gap.
